blocks.html:
Ferrous metal exposed in exterior locations shall be protected from corrosion by one of the following methods:
   1.   Zinc coatings (galvanizing).
   2.   Bonded coatings in accordance with Section 404.11.4.
   3.   Protective coatings in accordance with Section 404.11.5.
   4.   Protective wrappings in accordance with Section 404.11.6.
